# WiFi_CSI_Reservoir

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A method that uses Channel State Information (CSI) from WiFi signals as input to a reservoir computing system for sensing tasks. Bridges wireless communication and neuromorphic computing, enabling passive sensing without dedicated sensors.
